verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack mentions an AI-training policy or opt-out. Data can be kept out of Inngest's hands indirectly, by self-hosting the Inngest server or by encrypting function data with your own key through encryption middleware. Both are workarounds rather than a documented guarantee. missing for 10: an explicit policy or contractual commitment that customer data is not used to train AI models, an opt-out control on the hosted platform, independent corroboration.
